verdict: A showcase deck. FrizzleBob has gone full med school and the result is 56 consistently named characters covering every corner of biochemistry and cell biology. The STAT/POWER/LORE structure is flawlessly executed — clinical pearls are first-rate, counterintuitive, and board-relevant. Minor gripes: CDG is the lone card without a character name, and a handful of powers describe mechanism rather than invite performance. But p53 Guardian holding STOP signs, Porphyria Pete's never-give-phenytoin rule, and Golgi Gloria's I-cell disease lore? These are knockouts. Table-ready Y.
